prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns, sign-in hints, home waiting info, and home notifications were helpful, yielding multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, and finish hints consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated surprising winning layout, hint, and new screen changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the friend selection screen into a list layout featuring pet previews and direct selection controls. (why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s. Past results show adoption redesigns significantly boost user progression.)
1: [sign_in, hint] OAuth service status hint on sign-in screen: Display a dynamic authentication status hint below sign-in options to reassure users when sign-in loading delays occur. (why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s and support received emails reporting authentication screens stalling or failing to load.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet character personality quiz screen: Insert an interactive pet personality quiz screen right before friend selection to recommend ideal pets based on user answers. (why: Adoption stage has a high mean completion time (1017s); offering guided recommendations accelerates companion selection.)
3: [home, wait_info] Asset extraction progress breakdown on waiting screen: Enable detailed progress tracking and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare. (why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time (2336s). Detailed wait information has proven effective in prior iterations.)
4: [home, notification] System tray readiness callout notification on waiting screen: Add an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen that alerts users as soon as loading completes. (why: Home waiting duration exhibits long tails (mean 2336s). Notification toggles keep users engaged without abandoning the app.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in after pick friend selection screen: Move sign-in step to take place immediately after choosing a pet companion, prior to photo upload and adoption certificate. (why: Placing sign-in after pet choice leverages high emotional attachment to complete account registration earlier.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Pet voice preview flow screen: Insert a voice and sound preview screen following photo upload so users can sample audio traits before signing the certificate. (why: Support logs reveal user confusion about pet interactions and sounds. Adding voice preview builds clarity and commitment.)
7: [adoption, layout] Centered layout redesign for friend selection screen: Update the friend selection screen to use a centered focus layout emphasizing pet selection choices. (why: Adoption layout improvements have consistently driven conversion gains in earlier experiments.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Compact layout redesign for choose path screen: Rebuild the path selection screen with a compact layout to display quick preset choices clearly without scrolling. (why: Choose path has a mean duration of 514s; presenting path options in a streamlined layout helps users decide faster.)
